subject: POC Readiness runbook + outstanding blockers
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finera.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@finera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — initial runbook and acceptance criteria

Hi Alice / Tom —

Attaching the current MAP (finera_map_v1.2.pdf) and an evaluation checklist (evaluation_checklist.xlsx). Wanted to confirm acceptance criteria so we can lock the test window. Proposed acceptance for the POC milestone: 
- Throughput/latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for the baseline prompt set
- Functional correctness: pass the curated validation set with <= 5% hallucination score (as defined in the checklist)
- Security: completed data residency checklist and SOC-annotated evidence uploaded
- Operational: KV cache warmup and prefix caching validated per runbook

Can you confirm these are aligned with Finera's expectations, and call out any additions? If this looks good we will:
- Schedule the test run Nov 22–24
- Deliver acceptance report Nov 25
- Final decision timeline Nov 29

Quick asks:
- Please assign an internal owner for network/whitelisting if there are firewall/IP requirements
- Confirm the sample dataset path and any PII masking requirements

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachments: finera_map_v1.2.pdf (MAP v1.2, 12 pages), evaluation_checklist.xlsx (POC acceptance criteria)

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finera.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@finera.com>, finera-poc-ops@finera.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — initial runbook and acceptance criteria

Thanks Karthik — overall this looks good. A few additions/concerns from our side: 
- Add acceptance item: Data residency audit (proof that logs and artifacts remain in the agreed region)
- Blocker: Our infra team requires a fixed egress IP range for the POC so they can update firewall rules. They will need the list of IPs and CIDRs from Redwood.
- We will also require a short security questionnaire filled out for the network topology (can be the same doc as the network_runbook.md)

I’ve looped in finera-poc-ops@finera.com (ops team) who will act as the owner for whitelisting and sample dataset delivery.

Can Redwood provide the IPs and a one-page checklist for the residency evidence?

Appreciate it,
Alice Monroe
Director, Data Products | Finera
alice.monroe@finera.com
Attachment: none

Subject: Re: POC runbook — technical checklist and sizing notes

Quick technical update from the evaluation engineering side: 
- GPU sizing: for the target throughput we recommend 2x A10G equivalents for the trial stage (we can bin-pack if Finera needs smaller footprint)
- Quantization: we will run INT8 profile for the first pass; accuracy delta expected ~2–3% vs FP16 (see evaluation_checklist.xlsx for tolerances)
- Sample dataset: we need the masked sample by Nov 19 (S3 path + read role). Without this we cannot run the exact validation set.
- Inference harness: I’ve attached the harness commands and expected outputs in the evaluation_checklist.xlsx. I’ll run a dry run on Nov 21 to validate infra and reachability.

Blockers currently:
- Awaiting Finera whitelisting (IP blocks) — blocks the run start
- Waiting on masked sample dataset delivery

Drive link to run artifacts and the short run script: https://drive.google.com/finera/map_v1.2

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
